text:
ravi: heads up — onboarding CI for the new python sample hit a package mismatch: CI installs typing-extensions 4.5.x from our index but local poetry.lock says 4.6.x. results in runtime errors for `TypedDict` usage.
noa: that sounds like our artifactory cache serving an older wheel. any logs?
ravi: log snippet: ```Collecting typing-extensions==4.5.0
  Using cached typing_extensions-4.5.0-py3-none-any.whl (35 kB)
Successfully installed typing-extensions-4.5.0
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "app.py", line 7, in <module>
    from typing_extensions import TypedDict
ImportError: cannot import name 'TypedDict' from 'typing_extensions' (mainly available in 4.6+)
```
noa: weird that pip picked 4.5 when reqs.txt had 4.6. Did poetry export pin it as `typing-extensions==4.6.3`?
ravi: yes. reqs.txt contains `typing-extensions==4.6.3 	; python_version >= "3.8"` — but CI run shows a resolver fallback where pip resolves a compatible older distribution from our internal mirror.
gina: infra-bot: created ticket INFRA-872 about stale packages in artifactory. setting TTL purge for typing-extensions index to 1h.
noa: short-term workaround: in CI before pip install run `python -m pip install --upgrade pip` and `pip install --prefer-binary typing-extensions==4.6.3` to force the correct wheel. or `--no-cache-dir`/`--no-deps` if appropriate.
ravi: tried `--no-cache-dir`, still got cached mirror artifact. adding explicit `--index-url https://pypi.org/simple` fixed it but we'd rather not bypass internal index.
gina: infra will invalidate the artifact and re-mirror. also adding a health-check job that does `pip download typing-extensions==4.6.3 -i our-index` to detect mismatches in CI.
noa: long-term: document poetry->pip export caveats in devex onboarding. also consider adding a small `verify-packages.py` to sample-app that asserts installed package versions in CI.
ravi: filing sdk-python issue to add recommended CI snippet and recommend `pip` min version >= 23.1 because older pip handles markers differently: https://github.com/redwood/sdk-python/issues/331
gina: infra-bot: ticket INFRA-872 updated — purge scheduled, will post when mirror sync completes.
ravi: thanks all. pushed a temporary CI change to pin the typing-extensions install before dependencies, CI green so far. will revert once infra confirms mirror integrity. :white_check_mark:
